pages.text: Cursed Techniques are a sorcerer's means of attack; they occupy the core's $(bold)Cursed Technique slot$().$(li)A ritual grants one Cursed Technique at random, with a 30% chance of an extra slot (up to 3)$(li)Techniques are unleashed with the $(l:techniques/usage)bound key$(); when a core holds several techniques, use the cycle key to select between them$(li)The technique chapters in this book $(bold)unlock automatically$() once you obtain the matching technique$(br2)There are sixteen Cursed Techniques in total:$(li)$(l:techniques/yuchuzi)Yu Chu Zi$(): combines Dismantle / Cleave / Furnace: Open — three moves (cycle with F)$(li)$(l:techniques/blood_manipulation)Blood Manipulation$(): combines Piercing Blood / Hundred Convergence / Supernova — three moves (cycle with F)$(li)$(l:techniques/ten_shadows)Ten Shadows$(): summons ten kinds of shikigami$(li)$(l:techniques/black_bird)Black Bird Manipulation$(): controls black birds that fly, dive and self-destruct$(li)$(l:techniques/puppet)Puppet Manipulation$(): directly controls Iron Golems / Snow Golems (attack / knockback / throw snowballs / self-destruct)$(li)$(l:techniques/plant_manipulation)Plant Manipulation$(): binds with roots / parasitizes with cursed seeds / reverses to drain plants and restore mana$(li)$(l:techniques/flame_manipulation)Flame Manipulation$(): spawns 3×3 lava-magma underfoot / reverses to summon self-destructing Phantoms$(li)$(l:techniques/cursed_spirit)Cursed Spirit Manipulation$(): tames dying undead / releases them as servants / sacrifices them to charge a black vortex$(li)$(l:techniques/lightning_manipulation)Lightning Manipulation$(): smites with lightning as cursed damage / unlocks "Amber" to add lightning to basic attacks$(li)$(l:techniques/sky_manipulation)Sky Manipulation$(): normal — launches the target flying, or self-propels a dash with no target; reversed — fires Ushiora orbs that shatter ice and send targets flying$(li)$(l:techniques/projection)Projection Sorcery$(): touch an afterimage to gain a buff$(li)$(l:techniques/wuliang_wuxian)Infinity$(): damage reduction and reflection — a toggleable sustained technique$(li)$(l:techniques/wuliang_cang)Blue$(): an attracting orb (including Cursed Technique Reversal: Red and Hollow Technique: Purple)$(li)$(l:techniques/jacobs_ladder)Jacob's Ladder$(): a pillar of light that seals techniques and Domains$(li)$(l:techniques/reverse_cursed)Reverse Cursed Technique$(): heal yourself / release healing outward, or damage the undead$(li)$(l:techniques/wu_wei)Idle Transfiguration$(): normal — transfigure yourself; outward — transfigure targets
